text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions simply after they showed gains; next time I’ll use a clear target or thesis change, not the pleasure of locking in a profit, to decide when to sell.","A loss feels especially painful, but my purchase price is not a reason to keep a stock; I’ll reassess each holding on its current prospects and risks.","My account value can fall even after profitable sales, so I’ll judge decisions by the portfolio’s longer-term plan rather than a few monthly swings."]}
